Key discussions included the decline of the TSG deal by CACI and Ziff Davis, the interest from Momentum and Imaginary Content with upcoming calls, and onboarding progress with new buy-side client WE Group. Operational updates highlighted the preference for using the Clay tool over the Admin tool for cost efficiency, while strategic discussions addressed outreach capacities and potential investments related to WE Group. Financial matters included invoicing, payroll setup for Jack, and the need for pension details, while action items were assigned to various team members to follow up on discussions, clarify client needs, and facilitate setup processes. Closing talks emphasized the importance of increased outreach despite existing challenges, and the likelihood of outlining a pitch for a valuation of a business between $10-15 million.
